def test_unique_sorted():
    assert unique_sorted([3, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1]) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert unique_sorted([]) == []
    assert unique_sorted([5, 5, 5]) == [5]
    print("ALL TESTS PASSED")

if __name__ == '__main__':
